question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Annihilate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Destroy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Annihilate"** means to completely destroy or obliterate something, often in a violent or devastating way. (नष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The invading army aimed to annihilate the enemy forces in a single battle.
 
 
 
• **"Destroy"** refers to causing something to become ruined, damaged, or obliterated to the extent that it cannot be repaired or restored. (नष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The storm destroyed several homes in the coastal area.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Annihilate'** is **'Destroy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Destroy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Increase** (बढ़ना): To make something greater in size, amount, or intensity.

 
 
• **Example:** The company aims to increase its production capacity by 20% next year.
 
 
 
• **Confirm** (पुष्टि करना): To establish the truth or validity of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor confirmed the diagnosis after conducting several tests.
 
 
 
• **Lengthen** (लंबा करना): To make something longer in duration or length.
 
 
• **Example:** She lengthened the skirt to make it more suitable for the occasion.
